title: The guide Beqa was nice...

title: Barcelona's Visual Gems
text: Clara's tour of Barcelona's visual gems was wonderful. She showed me the city's charm through the lens of a camera. I now have beautiful pictures and lasting memories of this vibrant city.
author: 886isabellaw
